failure: The approved DOCX contract surface was replaced concurrently by a Markdown file before initialization verification.
adaptation: Re-inspected the worktree and configured the Markdown rules file as the authoritative contract surface.
rule: Resolve and verify the authoritative contract-surface path immediately before writing or validating initialization artifacts.

failure: The installed pnpm 7.1.7 client failed registry metadata requests under Node 26 with ERR_INVALID_THIS.
adaptation: Selected a current pnpm release through Corepack for Node 26 compatibility.
rule: Use a pnpm release that supports the repository runtime Node version.

failure: pnpm 11 stopped installation because the esbuild dependency build script lacked an explicit approval.
adaptation: Declared esbuild in pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies and repeated the install.
rule: Declare approved dependency build scripts in package.json so pnpm installs remain non-interactive.

failure: pnpm 11 ignored pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies in package.json and still rejected the esbuild build script.
adaptation: Moved onlyBuiltDependencies to pnpm-workspace.yaml, where pnpm 11 reads build-policy settings.
rule: Store pnpm 11 build-policy settings in pnpm-workspace.yaml rather than the package.json pnpm field.

failure: pnpm aborted a non-interactive modules-directory refresh because it could not ask for purge confirmation.
adaptation: Configured confirmModulesPurge false for deterministic repository installs.
rule: Configure pnpm installs to handle modules-directory refreshes without an interactive terminal.

failure: pnpm read onlyBuiltDependencies but its active allowBuilds policy still left esbuild unset and rejected installation.
adaptation: Set allowBuilds.esbuild to true in the repository pnpm workspace configuration.
rule: Set explicit true or false values in pnpm allowBuilds when the active pnpm policy exposes dependency build decisions there.

failure: A prior pnpm run appended an unresolved allowBuilds placeholder after the repository configuration, which created duplicate YAML keys.
adaptation: Removed the generated placeholder and kept one explicit esbuild approval.
rule: Inspect pnpm-workspace.yaml after a rejected pnpm build-policy run because pnpm can append unresolved allowBuilds entries.

failure: TypeScript did not retain the queried root-element null check inside the render closure.
adaptation: Bound the checked element to a non-null application-root constant before closure use.
rule: Bind checked DOM query results to a non-null constant before nested functions capture them under strict TypeScript.

failure: The first production build named the CSS asset index.css while the shell cache expected style.css, and ESLint lacked service-worker globals.
adaptation: Made the CSS output name explicit and added a service-worker lint environment.
rule: Check production asset names against the service-worker cache list and lint worker files with worker globals.

failure: The initial format check included the out-of-scope README and reported pre-existing formatting there.
adaptation: Excluded README.md and formatted only T01-owned application and tooling files.
rule: Exclude out-of-scope contract and user files from repository-wide formatter checks when the ticket cannot change them.

failure: Prettier could not infer a parser for the PWA SVG icon and stopped before static checks.
adaptation: Excluded the static SVG icon from the formatter while retaining it in lint and build checks.
rule: Exclude static asset formats that the configured formatter cannot parse from format checks.

failure: The focused browser check found a blank document after an offline reload even though the service worker reported every shell URL cached.
adaptation: Normalized navigation requests to the cached index path and asset requests to pathname cache keys.
rule: Use stable pathname cache keys for service-worker navigation and shell asset lookups instead of matching raw reload requests.

failure: Playwright offline routing loaded the cached shell but did not change navigator.onLine, so the network badge stayed online.
adaptation: Kept the browser check on the observable offline reload and retained network-state coverage at the readiness seam.
rule: Do not use Playwright request-offline mode as proof of navigator.onLine state; use it to check cached navigation behavior.

failure: Corepack could not create its user-cache directory inside the managed workspace sandbox.
adaptation: Ran the repository-installed tool binaries directly for focused checks.
rule: Use repository-installed tool binaries when managed sandbox permissions prevent Corepack from creating its user cache.

failure: The focused Playwright check could not start the local Vite preview server because the managed workspace sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Reran the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The focused Playwright check served the prior production output and could not find the new Start Match control.
adaptation: Rebuilt the production output before repeating the focused browser check.
rule: Run the production build before Playwright checks because the configured Vite preview server serves dist rather than source files.

failure: The focused Playwright acceptance check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Retried the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The offline cold-start check reloaded before the newly registered service worker reached its ready state.
adaptation: Waited for navigator.serviceWorker.ready before the controlled-page reload.
rule: Wait for service-worker readiness before a browser check reloads to assert page control and offline shell state.

failure: Programmatic element focus did not activate Chrome focus-visible styling in the accessibility check.
adaptation: Changed the check to navigate controls with keyboard Tab input and inspect the focused control.
rule: Use keyboard navigation rather than programmatic focus when browser checks assert focus-visible styling.

failure: The configured format check rejected the new Playwright acceptance test.
adaptation: Formatted only the Test-owned acceptance file with the repository formatter.
rule: Run the repository formatter on new Test-owned TypeScript files before the configured format check.

failure: The configured full suite failed because Vitest collected the Playwright browser specifications and rejected Playwright test declarations.
adaptation: Added Test-owned Vitest configuration that excludes the Playwright test directory from Vitest collection.
rule: Configure Vitest to exclude Playwright specifications when one repository command runs both test runners.

failure: The latest TypeScript 7 package has no compiler API, so the latest typescript-eslint release stopped during lint startup.
adaptation: Used the official TypeScript 6 compatibility alias for tooling and kept TypeScript 7 as the build compiler through an exact npm alias.
rule: Run TypeScript 7 beside the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package while lint tooling still needs the TypeScript compiler API.

failure: The required dependency freshness command resolved the global pnpm 7.1.7 client, which rejected the JSON format option.
adaptation: Used Corepack to select the repository-declared pnpm 11.22.0 client for dependency checks.
rule: Run dependency checks with the repository-declared package-manager version when the global client does not support the required command contract.

failure: The focused Playwright acceptance check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Retried the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The Codebox constitution omitted the required phases.planning route, so Planning could not start.
adaptation: Stopped before feature state or branch changes because the orchestrator cannot fall back to the default route.
rule: Configure phases.planning as frontier before a Codebox feature starts.

failure: pnpm selected the user-level store while the existing modules directory was linked to the repository-local store.
adaptation: Repeated dependency installation with the repository-local pnpm store path.
rule: Use the repository-local pnpm store when adding dependencies to an existing modules directory linked there.

failure: The package-manager wrapper attempted registry resolution while running configured checks in the network-restricted sandbox.
adaptation: Ran the installed repository tool binaries directly for deterministic focused verification.
rule: Use installed repository tool binaries for verification when the package-manager wrapper performs network resolution.

failure: Adding reference fields directly to roster character objects broke the established exact Ruleset character contract test.
adaptation: Kept gameplay roster characters stable and exposed enriched immutable referenceCharacters beside them.
rule: Preserve the minimal gameplay roster object shape when adding richer Ruleset reference data.

failure: Corepack pnpm aborted the focused browser check while attempting a non-interactive modules-directory purge.
adaptation: Ran the installed Playwright binary directly while retaining the configured browser project and preview server.
rule: Invoke the installed Playwright binary directly when Corepack pnpm triggers a modules-directory refresh during verification.

failure: The focused Playwright check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback listener.
adaptation: Repeated the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The repository pnpm wrapper launched an automatic dependency-status install and stalled on registry retries instead of running configured local scripts.
adaptation: Stopped the wrapper and used the installed repository binaries for deterministic static and focused verification.
rule: Use installed repository binaries for verification when the pnpm wrapper starts an unrequested registry-dependent install.

failure: The configured full suite timed out in the phone shell check because it reloaded before the newly registered service worker became ready and controlling.
adaptation: Blocked Test with the exact failing check for a fresh implementer; did not rerun the full suite or change production behavior.
rule: Wait for service-worker readiness before reloading in browser acceptance checks that require a controlled page.

failure: TypeScript rejected in-place expansion of a readonly search highlight range during overlap merging.
adaptation: Replaced the last merged range with a new expanded range object.
rule: Merge readonly search ranges by replacing entries rather than mutating their fields.

failure: The focused Playwright remediation check could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied its loopback listener.
adaptation: Repeated the focused browser check with explicit local-server permission.
rule: Run Playwright browser checks with local-server permission when the managed workspace sandbox blocks the Vite preview listener.

failure: The focused browser workflow assumed Backstab search produced one link after the production index gained broader matching section records.
adaptation: Selected the deterministic first-ranked ability result and added explicit production result-count and ordering assertions.
rule: Browser search checks must select by deterministic rank when full-text indexing intentionally returns both narrow and broader records.

failure: Focused lint found the current Ruleset version import became unused after restoration validation stopped hard-coding the bundled version.
adaptation: Removed the obsolete import and reran the bounded static checks.
rule: Remove bundled-version imports when persistence validation is generalized to the saved version contract.

failure: The focused browser command named chromium-phone and chromium-tablet, but the repository config exposes phone and tablet.
adaptation: Read the Playwright configuration and selected its exact project names.
rule: Read Playwright project names from the repository configuration before filtering focused browser checks.

failure: The simultaneous-elimination browser setup read the active character before an asynchronous Finish Turn commit completed, then damaged the actual active character and disabled Basic Attack.
adaptation: Waited for the rendered active-character heading to change before deriving the protected finalists.
rule: Browser workflows must wait for the observable committed turn change before deriving targets from the new active character.

failure: A concurrent writer changed the active feature immutable model-routing snapshot before Test routing.
adaptation: Stopped before Test and requested user guidance without changing the concurrent routing values.
rule: Do not change a Codebox feature model_routing snapshot after Planning creates it.

failure: The configured full-suite command ran vendored third-party tests from .opencode/node_modules (zod), failing 3 files unrelated to the project.
adaptation: Added .opencode/** to the vitest exclude list so vendor tests never enter the configured suite.
rule: Keep vendored dependency trees out of the configured full-suite test command.

failure: The canonical End Game validation rejected Matches ended without Team Elimination.
adaptation: Expanded MatchEnded validation to allow an empty eliminatedTeams list with winner determined by Decision Basis.
rule: Allow MatchEnded events with no eliminated teams for manual End Game decision-basis outcomes.

failure: Existing contract restore expectations omitted the Match Summary after the store added a summary field.
adaptation: Updated contract expectations to include summary null and summary-aware assertions.
rule: Include the latest Match Summary in all restore expectations when the store contract returns a summary field.

failure: codebox-handoff to frontier model returned no structured text despite routing match
adaptation: Implemented T01 directly in orchestrator and marked T02-T06 blocked with concrete next actions
rule: When frontier handoff returns no structured response, implement one minimal vertical slice directly and mark remaining tickets blocked with explicit blockers rather than retrying blindly

failure: A chained shell assembly replaced match-store.test.ts before the second sed range extracted the lifecycle suite from it, yielding an empty test file.
adaptation: Confirmed the file was unmodified at HEAD and re-extracted the byte-exact range from git show HEAD output.
rule: Extract verbatim line ranges for every split target from git HEAD before modifying or replacing any source file.

failure: codebox_handoff child session returned no structured text response three times in a row for a small config-only ticket (max-params default switch), making zero repository changes each time
adaptation: Persisted the owning phase as blocked and stopped for human guidance instead of implementing in the orchestrator
rule: When repeated codebox_handoff dispatches return no structured response and produce no tree changes, treat the channel as operationally blocked after at most three attempts, persist blocked state, and stop for user guidance

failure: The configured full suite failed 9 contract tests because the max-params remediation regrouped trailing parameters of public domain commands (endMatch, rerollInitiative, undoLastEvent, ruleSimultaneousElimination) into command objects while tsconfig include covers only src, so untouched positional callers in tests/contract were never type-checked and broke only at runtime.
adaptation: Blocked Test with a precise production-compatibility blocker instead of rewriting committed contract expectations to fit the changed API.
rule: When changing public function signatures, type-check or execute every consumer directory; tsc include omits tests/, so tests/contract catches API breaks only when the full vitest suite runs.

failure: After the contract-caller migration the criterion-5 full suite still showed 18 Playwright failures, and the working tree alone could not show whether the in-flight branch caused them.
adaptation: Rebuilt the merge-base 577250c and HEAD 7450ba3 commits in throwaway worktrees, served each build, and reproduced all 18 failures identically on both baselines, attributing them to stale version-1 IndexedDB opens and post-reopen winner-banner expectations that predate the feature.
rule: Attribute full-suite Playwright failures to a merge-base worktree build before treating them as regressions of in-flight changes.

failure: pnpm run format:check failed on 20 files outside ticket T05 scope (untracked playwright-cli skill assets, a .playwright-cli page snapshot, and pnpm-lock.yaml drifted by an out-of-band @playwright/cli dependency addition) while all three ticket-owned spec files stayed Prettier-clean.
adaptation: Proved owned files clean with a scoped prettier check and git status, attributed the drift to pre-dispatch tooling changes, and reported it instead of editing or reverting out-of-scope files.
rule: When format:check fails only on files outside the ticket scope ownership, verify owned files individually and report the foreign drift rather than modifying files another change owns.

failure: Extending tsconfig include to the whole tests tree newly type-checked tests/browser and tests/contract, surfacing pre-existing type errors unrelated to the test relocation.
adaptation: Scoped the include to only the relocated unit-test locations (tests/*.test.ts plus tests/domain, tests/storage, tests/rules-reference), preserving the previous checking surface.
rule: Do not sweep previously unchecked test trees into tsc coverage wholesale; extend coverage only over files an assignment moves, and expect pre-existing errors in tests/browser and tests/contract when wiring full type-checked tooling.

failure: Enabling recommendedTypeChecked crashed lint with rule-requires-type-information because typescript-eslint 8.67 presets are rules-only and no longer bundle parserOptions.projectService.
adaptation: Added explicit languageOptions.parserOptions.projectService on the scoped preset block in eslint.config.js instead of relying on preset-bundled parser options.
rule: Wire typed-linting parser options explicitly when using typescript-eslint presets in this repository; do not assume presets include projectService.

failure: eslint-plugin-functional recommended preset surfaced 1816 errors across 41 files: in every published major (v6-v10) recommended bans expression statements, throw statements, loops, let bindings, void returns and parameterless functions, and older majors are peer-incompatible with ESLint 10.
adaptation: Reverted the config wiring and dependency install to restore the green T02 baseline and returned a Planning blocker instead of rewriting the imperative DOM application or silently switching presets.
rule: Treat eslint-plugin-functional recommended as a whole-paradigm functional-programming ruleset; pick plugin version, preset and option tuning at planning time before a ticket enables it.

failure: Resuming T03 on the stated T02 baseline, eslint --print-config showed empty parserOptions: the prior T03 revert had restored the HEAD eslint.config.js, silently downgrading recommendedTypeChecked to plain recommended while keeping T02 source fixes.
adaptation: Rebuilt the flat config before any rule fixes: restored recommendedTypeChecked via an extends block with projectService over tsconfig-covered globs, and verified the resolved config empirically instead of trusting handoff claims.
rule: Verify lint-baseline claims with eslint --print-config (parser wiring and rule presence) before building on a reverted tree.

failure: Scoping recommendedTypeChecked behind files+extends while dropping the global tseslint preset spread left tests/browser and tests/contract on the espree parser, causing TS-syntax parse errors and no-undef failures that the old config did not have.
adaptation: Kept the global ...tseslint.configs.recommended spread for repo-wide parser and base rules, layered type-checked rules only over tsconfig-covered globs, and added browser/node globals blocks for tests/browser and tests/contract.
rule: In typescript-eslint flat configs the global preset spread supplies parser wiring for all .ts files; scoped extends blocks do not, so keep the global spread and give non-src test trees explicit globals.

failure: Constitution format:check failed on 29 files at Test: 28 files this feature edited were prettier-clean at merge-base but left unformatted because no Code ticket ran the format gate.
adaptation: Attributed every failure against merge-base content, proved 28 are feature-introduced and wrangler.jsonc is pre-existing foreign drift, and blocked with the precise file list instead of reformatting Code-owned sources after the single full-suite run.
rule: Run pnpm run format:check during Code verification before handoff; Test attributes formatting failures by owner and blocks rather than reformatting files another phase owns.

failure: Passing a newline-separated multi-file list to pnpm exec prettier as an unquoted shell variable produced a single malformed pattern and formatted nothing.
adaptation: Piped the file list through xargs so each path arrived as a separate argument.
rule: In this repository's zsh shell, expand multi-path command arguments via xargs or word-forcing expansion, never bare variable interpolation.

failure: Canonical ActionResolved validation rejected Ability heal and revival effects because every effect was required to satisfy hpAfter === max(0, hpBefore - damage), a Basic-Attack-era damage-only ledger.
adaptation: Narrowly extended the canonical effect contract so Ability events with zero damage and increasing HP are admitted; Basic Attack validation stayed unchanged.
rule: Validate new Match Event shapes against the canonical storage validators (match-store-canonical-event.ts), not only domain replay, before shipping a UI commit path.

failure: The inherited rules-coverage storage audit suite failed at collection because a module-level fixture ran startMatch on a setup state with no generated initiative.
adaptation: Typed the slot helper against ActiveMatchState, removed the import-time probe, and built the marked history inside each test.
rule: Build domain command fixtures inside test bodies rather than at module import time so one invalid probe cannot fail an entire suite.

failure: The full-suite browser half failed all 100 Playwright tests at launch because the machine-level Playwright browser cache was empty for the installed 1.62.1 client.
adaptation: Installed the matching Chromium headless shell with the repository Playwright binary and reran the full suite successfully.
rule: Install the pinned Playwright browsers before running the configured suite on a fresh machine.

failure: The in-flight Use Ability extensions left match-abilities.ts at 823 lines, failing the strict eslint max-lines gate during the rules audit.
adaptation: Extracted the non-attack utility application switch into a behavior-preserving match-ability-utility module and reran the focused domain suites.
rule: Check module size after extending large files because strict max-lines enforcement turns further in-place extension into a lint gate failure.

failure: A storage-seam fixture called resolveBasicAttack with a source that was not the Active Character because finishTurn was counted as passing slots rather than closing them.
adaptation: Rebuilt the turn sequence so each finishTurn closes the current initiative slot and the attack executes with the Active Character as source.
rule: Count each finishTurn as closing the current initiative slot and call resolveBasicAttack only while its source is the Active Character.

failure: The configured full suite failed an inherited ability-draft expectation requiring Battle Hymn to leave the Ranger at 2/3 HP although that buff deals no damage.
adaptation: Corrected the Test-owned literal to expect the unwounded printed 3/3 total, consistent with the rules document and audit fixtures, then reran the full suite once.
rule: Re-validate inherited browser expectations against independent rules literals before trusting a claimed green baseline; non-damaging abilities must assert unchanged printed HP.

failure: A new storage-seam test committed only the final overridden resolution and the store rejected it because the record did not continue the committed sequence from SetupCreated.
adaptation: Collected every event of the Match history (setup, initiative, start, turns) and committed them in order before the overridden resolution.
rule: IndexedDbMatchStore.commit enforces sequence continuity, so store-seam tests must commit the complete event history in order rather than a single terminal event.

failure: A browser test timed out waiting for a Start Match click only under full-suite load after an edit; the error-context snapshot showed the action had already committed, which was first misread as a Playwright click-vs-rerender race.
adaptation: Diffed the edited spec against the intended change and found an accidentally duplicated transition click: in fast runs the second dispatch lands before the success re-render retires the button, but under load the re-render wins and the duplicate waits 30s for a gone button; removing the duplicate restored determinism.
rule: When a UI-test click times out on a control whose success path removes it, diff the test file against the intended edit for duplicated or stray interaction lines before blaming framework races; never leave a state-transition click duplicated because it only fails under load.

failure: eslint-plugin-svelte flat/recommended parsed script lang=ts component content as plain JavaScript, failing the typed $props() destructure in the new placeholder with a JS parse error despite 37 active svelte rules.
adaptation: Set languageOptions.parserOptions.parser to the typescript-eslint parser on the **/*.svelte config block so svelte-eslint-parser delegates TypeScript scripts.
rule: Wire typescript-eslint as parserOptions.parser for *.svelte files when enabling eslint-plugin-svelte; its presets do not wire TS script parsing.

failure: Vitest node-environment runs made vite-plugin-svelte compile .svelte.ts runes modules for the server consumer, where $effect.root ignores its callback entirely, so store-reactivity tests observed no effect runs even after flushSync.
adaptation: Forced generate client via svelte dynamicCompileOptions under VITEST with browser resolve conditions so tests bind the client runtime, and awaited tick() instead of flushSync because the first queued effect run is not covered by flushSync.
rule: Unit-testing Svelte 5 runes effects under Vitest requires forcing client rune compilation plus browser package conditions, and effects must be flushed with await tick() rather than flushSync alone.

failure: Converting the shell main element to Svelte moved its inert binding to the reactive flush, so closing the Rules dialog refocused its opener while main was still inert and the browser specs failed on focus return.
adaptation: Kept the inert flag in render() as a synchronous toggleAttribute call beside the legacy surface swap and removed the competing Svelte binding.
rule: Apply DOM flags that gate synchronous post-render focus or interaction inside the render step that rebuilds the surfaces, not through deferred component reactivity.

failure: The svelte/no-at-html-tags lint gate rejected every new {@html} hop, including reactive hosting of characterNameHtml output inside the converted setup components.
adaptation: Expressed character-name rendering as real conditional markup in a shared CharacterName component and reserved {@html} for transitional shared legacy templates with explicit justified suppressions.
rule: Converted Svelte surfaces must render name markup as real component markup; {@html} is acceptable only for hosting repository-owned legacy template strings until their conversion ticket, behind a scoped eslint-disable.

failure: Passing .svelte files to the repository prettier errored with no inferred parser although the repo-wide format:check reported no .svelte findings.
adaptation: Formatted only the ticket-owned TypeScript sources and treated .svelte formatting as outside this repository formatter coverage.
rule: This repository prettier has no Svelte plugin: format:check silently skips .svelte files during directory scans and direct per-file invocation errors, so never route .svelte sources through prettier here.

failure: Converting the active board to Svelte markup left raw newline-indent runs inside sentences around interpolations, so Playwright regex text assertions like /combat data for Ruleset BB-prior-release is not bundled/ found nothing although all string-match assertions still passed.
adaptation: Composed such sentences as single single-spaced text expressions and kept every regex-covered phrase contiguous on one source line.
rule: When converting panels to Svelte markup, keep every phrase a Playwright REGEX text assertion spans as one contiguous single-spaced run; string matchers normalize whitespace but regex matchers receive raw text.

failure: Removing the legacy renderer confirm/cancel listeners along with the converted board controls left the still-legacy Ended Match panel embedded confirmation buttons dead, failing removal and start-new browser flows.
adaptation: Restored #confirm-action/#cancel-action wiring beside the ended-panel controls with an until-T08 comment.
rule: Before pruning renderer event wiring during a surface conversion, inventory every remaining legacy template that embeds shared confirmation fragments relying on those listeners.

failure: Converting draft panels to Svelte kept multi-line text runs inside labels; specs using getByLabel(/Paladin · Drow/) timed out although getByRole(name) and string getByLabel matched, because regex label probes receive raw label text while role-name and string matchers normalize whitespace.
adaptation: Composed every spec-matched label phrase (contacts, reaction choices, ability targets) as one contiguous single-spaced source line inside its span.
rule: Treat getByLabel(REGEX) like regex text matchers: keep every phrase such a probe spans contiguous single-spaced in component markup; only getByRole name and string matchers normalize whitespace.

failure: Leg-review name separators written as literal " → " whitespace inside {#if} rendered as bare arrows because Svelte trims whitespace at control-flow block-content edges; ten joined names then became one unbreakable run whose min-content width expanded the mobile layout viewport (innerWidth 412→696) and Playwright confirm clicks failed hit-target checks reporting section/table interception.
adaptation: Moved separators into interpolated script constants ({LEG_NAME_SEPARATOR}) so spacing survives compilation, restoring wrappable legacy text and normal geometry.
rule: Never rely on literal template whitespace adjacent to {#if}/{#each} block edges for visible separators; emit them from script constants or expressions, and treat sudden Playwright hit-target interceptions on tall pages as horizontal overflow shrinking the layout viewport.

failure: Declaring a bind:this target with the dollar-state rune inside a Rules modal component that imports the shell store's state binding made the compiler resolve the rune as a subscription to that same-named local binding (store_rune_conflict).
adaptation: Captured the dialog element through a mount action into a plain non-reactive variable instead of a rune-typed bind:this target.
rule: In components importing the shell-state state snapshot, capture DOM nodes via use:-actions into plain variables; the pervasive state import makes every state-rune declaration resolve as a store subscription.

failure: Replacing the Ref delegate with deep $state cell wrappers made every shell snapshot read a reactive proxy; domain commands built from it carried proxies into IndexedDB and matchStore.commit failed with structured-clone errors on every command.
adaptation: Rebuilt each store cell as a plain snapshot holder plus a $state revision counter: wholesale replacement bumps the counter while reads return the raw installed value, preserving Ref reactivity semantics with no proxies leaving the store.
rule: Never expose deep-$state proxies to the domain or storage layers in this repository; pair raw value holders with $state revision counters when a runes module needs whole-value reactivity over structured-clone-safe snapshots.

failure: Ticket T01 cannot reach its required green build and focused tests: deleting LEGACY_MATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION and migrateLegacyMatch from the domain facade leaves src/storage/match-store.ts importing nonexistent exports (TS2305 under tsc --noEmit), and its schema-2 restore path plus migration tests in tests/storage/match-store.test.ts depend on the deleted MatchMigrated validation arm.
adaptation: Made no source changes and returned a planning blocker instead of editing another ticket's ownership area; the store restore() branch and migration store/E2E tests are reserved for T02.
rule: Sequence cross-layer symbol deletions so every consumer of the deleted exports (store restore branch, migration store/E2E tests) changes in the same ticket that removes them.

failure: T03 preset swap referenced eslint.configs.strict, but the installed @eslint/js 10.0.1 exports only recommended and all; the config resolved to undefined and ESLint failed to load.
adaptation: Routed the non-typed strict layer through tseslint.configs.strict (matching the spec wording "typescript-eslint strict non-typed preset") while keeping eslint.configs.recommended for .svelte scripts and public/sw.js coverage; documented in a config comment.
rule: In this repository, base ESLint strict does not exist under @eslint/js v10; use typescript-eslint presets for strict tiers and never drop eslint.configs.recommended because JS/Svelte files depend on it.

failure: Fixing no-unnecessary-condition by deleting the final literal disjunct of trailing guard chains (decisionBasis/coinFlipResult validation) would have made an earlier disjunct reject legal values such as "Duergar" and "coinFlip" at runtime, silently breaking valid persisted data.
adaptation: Replaced those chain fixes with widened-subject comparisons (const x: string = typed.value) so every literal check stays live and compile-time narrowing is preserved via user-defined type guards where downstream narrowing was needed.
rule: When satisfying no-unnecessary-condition on guards that validate persisted data, widen the compared subject instead of deleting trailing literal disjuncts; verify each surviving disjunct still accepts exactly the original value set.

failure: The dedicated linked worktree had no node_modules directory, so repository-installed ESLint and Vitest binaries could not start.
adaptation: Reused the dependency installation from the primary worktree at the same commit through an ignored node_modules symlink.
rule: Before focused checks in a linked worktree, provide its node_modules from a dependency installation whose lockfile and commit match the worktree.

failure: A whole-directory node_modules symlink made Vite and the Svelte plugin write their temporary caches through the link into the sandbox-read-only primary worktree.
adaptation: Replaced the symlink with a writable copy-on-write clone of the matching dependency installation.
rule: Linked-worktree Vite checks require a writable node_modules directory; use a matching writable installation rather than a whole-directory symlink.

failure: Extracting Active Match prompt classification left two visibility checks referencing the former local acknowledgement boolean, and ESLint rejected the undefined identifier.
adaptation: Rebased both visibility checks on the equivalent acknowledged prompt discriminant returned by the extraction.
rule: When extracting a derived presentation discriminant, update every downstream condition to consume that discriminant and run a focused static check before behavioral tests.

failure: Focused Playwright checks timed out because the restricted sandbox denied the configured preview server permission to listen on 127.0.0.1:4173.
adaptation: Reran the same focused browser command with approved local-server permissions; all 18 checks passed.
rule: Run repository Playwright checks with permission to bind the configured loopback preview-server port.

failure: Scoped lint rejected seven newly extracted helpers because their positional signatures exceeded the repository max-params limit.
adaptation: Replaced the positional signatures with immutable context objects and reran the focused lint gate successfully.
rule: Use immutable context objects for extracted helpers that need more than three inputs in this repository.

failure: The first Basic Attack extraction left validateBasicAttack at complexity 21, one branch above the default ESLint maximum.
adaptation: Extracted ordered contact normalization and validation into a separate named operation, then reran scoped complexity lint.
rule: After splitting a complex function, check every extracted helper against the complexity rule and separate cohesive validation stages that remain above the default maximum.

failure: Extracted store operations used a project-owned context type that the functional immutability gate classified as shallow-readonly.
adaptation: Introduced a local recursive deep-readonly context type for extracted transaction operations and kept domain values structurally immutable.
rule: Extracted helpers that receive aggregate project-owned contexts must use a recursive deep-readonly context type under this repository's functional immutability gate.

failure: The configured pnpm 11 launcher hung before printing even its version or starting the lint script, while repository-installed binaries ran normally.
adaptation: Used ./node_modules/.bin/prettier and ./node_modules/.bin/eslint for focused format/config checks and the equivalent repository-wide lint command.
rule: When the package-manager launcher hangs before command startup, verify the underlying repository-installed tool directly and report the launcher failure separately.

failure: The Homebrew pnpm 11.23.0 launcher produced no output and hung before even reporting its version under Node 26.5.0, blocking the configured lint script.
adaptation: Resolved pnpm through the bundled Codebox fallback runtime; pnpm 11.19.0 then ran the configured lint script successfully.
rule: When the system pnpm launcher hangs before startup, use the bundled Codebox fallback pnpm runtime for repository checks.

failure: Prettier format check failed on pnpm-lock.yaml due to quote style mismatch between pnpm single quotes and Prettier double quotes.
adaptation: Added pnpm-lock.yaml to .prettierignore and formatted pnpm-workspace.yaml to match Prettier style.
rule: Ignore generated lockfiles from Prettier checks to avoid perpetual formatting churn between package manager and formatter.

failure: Active-effect checks pushed the canonical-event validator beyond repository line and complexity limits.
adaptation: Extracted action metadata and effect-collection checks into a bounded storage helper with small validators.
rule: Keep canonical event validators within size and complexity limits by extracting cohesive action-validation helpers.

failure: Linked-worktree setup could not create the feature branch because the managed sandbox denied the Git refs lock write.
adaptation: Used the user-approved current-workspace fallback and preserved unrelated worktree content.
rule: When managed sandbox permissions block linked-worktree Git metadata writes, stop the setup and use an explicitly approved current-workspace fallback without retrying or cleaning unrelated paths.

failure: The T01 implementer reported blocked after final edits because it did not rerun owned checks or update the ticket and feature report artifacts.
adaptation: Re-ran the isolated T01 contract, type, lint, format, and whitespace loop before updating the owned ticket and report records.
rule: Before reporting an implementation ticket as blocked after edits, rerun every owned check and persist the ticket and feature outcome artifacts.

failure: The final TypeScript check exposed DisplayNames as a required full record even though Match Setup legitimately initializes it empty.
adaptation: Changed DisplayNames to a readonly partial record while retaining the closed CharacterId key type.
rule: Model canonical keyed maps with a readonly Partial Record when the valid empty state has no assigned keys.

failure: The configured Prettier installation had no Svelte parser and rejected changed Svelte files during the scoped format check.
adaptation: Ran Prettier on changed TypeScript files and used Svelte diagnostics plus ESLint for changed Svelte files without altering tooling.
rule: When the repository formatter lacks a Svelte parser, format supported source files and verify Svelte files with the configured Svelte and lint checks.

failure: The focused contextual Rules browser test could not start the Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback bind at 127.0.0.1:4173 with listen EPERM.
adaptation: Captured the exact operational blocker and did not substitute unrelated browser evidence; left T03 incomplete pending an approved browser-server run.
rule: When the managed sandbox denies the configured Playwright preview-server loopback bind, record the exact EPERM address and port and return blocked without substituting unrelated browser evidence.

failure: The focused T04 Playwright Rules Reference phone file could not start its Vite preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback bind with listen EPERM at 127.0.0.1:4173.
adaptation: Recorded the exact operational blocker and stopped completion duties without substituting non-browser evidence; the orchestrator must provide local-server permission before the phone browser check can run.
rule: When the managed sandbox denies the configured Playwright preview-server loopback bind, record the exact EPERM address and port and return blocked for orchestrator-authorized local-server execution.

failure: Typing a test helper's normalized lookup as the closed AbilityName union rejected existing ASCII-apostrophe aliases for curly-apostrophe configured names during repository type checks.
adaptation: Kept the lookup input as string while retaining the centralized closed union on Match Configuration values.
rule: Helpers that normalize external or test display spellings should accept string inputs; apply closed unions to stored semantic configuration fields and branch keys.

failure: The focused Playwright acceptance command could not start the configured preview server because the managed sandbox denied the loopback bind with listen EPERM at 127.0.0.1:4173.
adaptation: Persisted the exact blocker and stopped Test without rerunning the full suite or substituting partial browser evidence; local-server permission is required.
rule: When the managed sandbox denies the configured Playwright preview-server loopback bind, record the exact EPERM address and port and return blocked without substituting unrelated browser evidence.

failure: The configured full Vitest suite collected an unrelated .worktrees/eslint-simpler checkout and its dependencies.
adaptation: Preserve the user-owned checkout and exclude .worktrees/** from Vitest test discovery before rerunning the full suite.
rule: Exclude linked worktree directories from root test discovery so repository suites do not collect foreign source, tests, or dependency fixtures.

failure: Adding Dash movement fields to CombatMatchState left reopenMatch constructing an ActiveMatchState without them, causing TS2322 and dropping turn economy at runtime.
adaptation: Copied the movement fields when reopening and added a Dash-to-End-Game-to-Reopen regression assertion.
rule: When extending shared Match State, audit explicit state reconstructions such as reopenMatch and add a transition test that preserves the new fields.

failure: Historical replay for a non-current configuration rejected a retired Ability ID in spent state and active-effect metadata because the shared Match State validator required the current Ability registry.
adaptation: Made replay-state Ability identity validation version-gated: current configuration remains registry-strict, while non-current configuration accepts non-empty historical identifiers; canonical storage still rejects non-current configurations.
rule: Validate historical replay metadata against its configuration-version boundary rather than the current Ability registry, while keeping canonical persistence strict for the current configuration.

failure: The full Playwright suite rejected persisted non-current-configuration Match Events before replay, despite the state-level historical Ability-ID validation remediation.
adaptation: Stopped Test after collecting the exact restore boundary and left production repair to a fresh implementer.
rule: When supporting historical Match replay, version-gate canonical event validation as well as snapshot-state validation before invoking replay.

failure: The Dash final full suite still rejected BB-prior-release snapshots during historical Match restore after event validation became version-gated.
adaptation: Stopped after the single configured full suite and left the required production repair to a fresh implementer.
rule: When historical Match configuration restore is supported, version-gate canonical snapshot validation as well as canonical event validation while keeping new commits current-version strict.

failure: Version-gating the canonical snapshot validator alone did not restore a BB-prior-release Match; assertRestoredMatch still invokes it without the saved configuration version.
adaptation: Reverted the ineffective validator-only edit and stopped after the assigned falsifiable attempt.
rule: When debugging historical Match restore, trace the saved configuration version through the restore entry point before relaxing a nested validator.

failure: After restoring a BB-prior-release Match, Finish Turn failed canonical commit because MatchStore called assertCommit without the saved configuration version, reapplying current-version validation.
adaptation: Passed the state configuration version to assertCommit for live commits so restored historical Matches retain their compatible validation boundary.
rule: When committing a restored historical Match, pass its saved configuration version through the canonical commit validator instead of defaulting to the current configuration.

failure: Vitest followed the repository's pnpm project link into an untracked .worktrees checkout and collected dependency and Playwright tests despite directory excludes.
adaptation: Restricted Vitest discovery to repository unit-test files matching tests/**/*.test.ts.
rule: Use an explicit Vitest include pattern for repository tests when package-manager links can resolve outside the repository root.

failure: Applying type-aware and functional ESLint rules to all tests exposed 96 existing browser and contract-test violations.
adaptation: Kept the requested all-test rule coverage in the config and stopped before rewriting unrelated acceptance tests.
rule: Treat all-test typed and functional lint expansion as a separate cleanup because it exposes existing browser and contract-test debt.

failure: dependency-cruiser 18.2.0 does not export its bundled sample rule modules, so the initial configuration could not import them.
adaptation: Declared the required circular and unresolvable rules locally in the repository configuration.
rule: Keep dependency-cruiser rules self-contained in the repository configuration; do not import its non-exported bundled rule files.

failure: Enabling dependency-cruiser TypeScript parsing exposed a pre-existing type-only cycle between match-configuration.ts and match-configuration/abilities.ts, blocking the real graph.
adaptation: Kept type-only edges and cycle enforcement enabled and left the required module change to its owning ticket.
rule: When enabling dependency graph checks, retain type-only edges and resolve resulting cycles in the owning module ticket; never baseline or exclude them.

failure: After migrating Active Match transitions to the application interface, legacy confirmation routing still inspected the stale shell Match and failed to open setup or present the established commit-error message after application-owned End Game/Reopen operations.
adaptation: Kept T05 lifecycle compatibility paths intact while routing T06 confirmations through application state and preserving the existing user-facing commit-error wording at the UI boundary; reran the affected phone and tablet browser flows.
rule: When application-owned Match transitions coexist with a compatibility shell, confirmation callers must resolve the current Match from the application interface and preserve legacy error wording at the presentation boundary until the shell compatibility path is removed.

failure: The partial T07 Svelte interface migration exposed TypeScript and Svelte-check errors for a missing PhysicalAttackCheck import, optional physical-confirmation values, an unreachable confirmation branch, and an unbound Rules dialog handler; ESLint also rejected the new context code and destructuring style.
adaptation: Stopped further refactoring at the user request and preserved the exact diagnostics for the next implementation pass.
rule: Run TypeScript, Svelte-check, and ESLint immediately after each Svelte interface migration before continuing broad compatibility removal.

failure: A directory-only dependency-cruiser allow-pattern falsely rejected the root-level src/readiness.ts module.
adaptation: Added an explicit root-module alternative to the application dependency allow-pattern.
rule: Account for root-level modules separately when dependency-cruiser path policies allow grouped directories.
